title: The Arithmetic of Chess Piece Strength on the n x n Board
summary: On the n x n chessboard, the move totals of distinct pieces satisfy a small number of striking arithmetic identities. The total diagonal mobility of the bishop and the total 8-neighbor mobility of the king are exactly proportional, with constant n/12, valid for every n. Among nontrivial boards, the strengths of two distinct pieces drawn from a natural thirteen-piece alphabet coincide only for n in {6, 8, 12}.
